item.title: Siemens Medical Solutions USA, Inc.: ACUSON Orgin ICE Ultrasound Imaging System REF: 11669400 Recall
item.product: ACUSON Orgin ICE Ultrasound Imaging System REF: 11669400
item.summary: A software issue identified in the ultrasound system may result in the unintended activation of the Color Doppler setting, which has not received FDA clearance. This unintended activation could cause the system to crash or become unresponsive. Product details: ACUSON Orgin ICE Ultrasound Imaging System REF: 11669400
item.affectedPeople: Worldwide - US Nationwide distribution in the states of CA, CT, KY, NC, TX and the countries of Germany, Italy, India.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
